Geographies Served Programs Internet Governance We conduct studies and promote national and international laws and regulations that acknowledge and support the Internet's role as a tool for social justice and equality. IT for Change, a submission to the Forum on Information and Democracy's Working Group on Artificial Intelligence. The Working Group sought feedback on three crucial areas: (i) AI system development and deployment; (ii) accountability frameworks; and (iii) AI governance. Education In collaboration with public education systems, the Center for Education and Technology, IT for Change, aims to develop participatory models that enhance teacher agency, school autonomy, adolescent education, and community involvement. To connect, develop, and collaborate at the school, district, and state levels, our field initiatives systemically integrate digital technology. Communities of practice, cooperative OER models, digital intelligence, and free and open technology are all topics of our research. Our work and research contribute to state and national curricula as well as the courses we offer in partnership with academic institutions. We challenge popular models that centralize control with bureaucracy and vendors or privatize education through outsourcing in our advocacy work with government institutions and civil society. We also make the case for the need and potential for empowering students to make their own decisions when it comes to digital technology Milestones & Track Record IT for Change has published influential research reports, provided inputs to national and global digital policies, and implemented community-based digital empowerment projects for marginalized groups. --> --> Leadership Team Abhineet Nayyar Senior Associate - Research and Policy Engagement GURUMURTHY KASINATHAN Director and Lead - Public EdTech Aditi Pillai Associate - Research and Policy Engagement ANITA GURUMURTHY Executive Director and Senior Fellow - Research & Policy Engagement Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAAAI0603A Registration Number S.NO 301/2000-2001 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2017/0173540 --> 80G AAAAI0603AF20099 12A AAAAI0603AE20042 FCRA 94421114 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2000 Impact IT for Change has influenced policy frameworks and development interventions related to digital rights, data governance, platform regulation, and gender equality in the digital economy.
